figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT month_key,MIN(day) first_day,MAX(day) last_day,MIN(day_index) first_idx FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-11' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), a AS (SELECT d.department_id,m.month_key,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date< m.first_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>=m.first_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) opening,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date<=m.last_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>m.last_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) closing,SUM(CASE WHEN e.termination_date BETWEEN m.first_day AND m.last_day AND h.end_date=e.termination_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exits FROM departments d CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN employment_history h ON h.department_id=d.department_id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=h.employee_id GROUP BY d.department_id,m.month_key), b AS (SELECT *, (opening+closing)/2.0 avg_h FROM a), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(exits) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) e3,SUM(avg_h) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) h3,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) n3 FROM b) SELECT department_id,month_key,opening,closing,exits,ROUND(100.0*exits/NULLIF(avg_h,0),2) exit_pct,CASE WHEN n3=3 THEN ROUND(100.0*e3/NULLIF(h3,0),2) ELSE NULL END rolling_pct FROM z WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY month_key DESC, opening DESC, closing DESC
